title: C Programming
tagline: Master the foundation of programming -- Learn C for system programming, embedded systems, and performance-critical applications.
overview: This course provides a solid foundation in C programming, the language that powers operating systems, embedded devices, and performance-critical applications.

You'll learn fundamental programming concepts, memory management, pointers, and data structures. The course emphasizes low-level understanding and system programming, preparing you for careers in embedded systems, operating systems, and high-performance computing.
learningOutcomes: Master C programming fundamentals and syntax
Understand and implement pointers and memory management
Work with arrays, strings, and structures
Implement common data structures (linked lists, stacks, queues)
Handle file operations and I/O streams
Write efficient and optimized C code

curriculum.title: C Fundamentals
topics: Introduction to C and development environment

curriculum.title: Structures & Unions
topics: Nested structures and arrays of structures
